title: Method and system for scalable and decentralized incremental machine learning which protects data privacy

pse.problem: Data privacy concerns prevent bringing sensitive patient data to an external processing unit for machine learning, limiting the effectiveness of centralized machine learning methods and algorithms
pse.solution_function: Distributed and decentralized incremental machine learning: A shared machine learned model is continuously optimized by the joint action of multiple client units using local updates based on their own data. The model is not distributed outside of the client units, maintaining data privacy.
pse.solution_structure: Central server unit manages a single machine learned model, client units possess local versions of the model and gather data for local updates.
pse.solution_implementation: Local updates summarize changes to the machine learned model based on local data. The central server unit uses these local updates to improve the shared model and downloads modified models back to the client units.
pse.effect: Allows for scalable, decentralized machine learning while preserving privacy of sensitive patient data
